blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
In a negotiation, can and could are your best friends. They help you ask for things in a polite way. Can you lower the price? Could we extend the deadline? Simple, polite, and powerful.

We use can for simple requests: "Can you send the quote today?" We use could to sound more polite: "Could you help me, please?" Both are easy to use.

Speaking with good manners is a way to speak with power. Today you learn five negotiation phrases and the rule for can and could. With these words, you can offer, accept, and negotiate with confidence.

items.q: According to the text, why are can and could useful in a negotiation?
options: They help you ask for things in a polite way
They are only for writing emails
They make the price go down
items.why: "They help you ask for things in a polite way."

items.q: Which word does the text call more polite?
items.why: "We use could to sound more polite."

items.q: "Can you send the quote today?" is an example of a…
items.why: O texto mostra essa frase como um pedido simples com can.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: can and could are only for beginners to avoid
polite words can make you stronger in a deal
items.why: Inferência: "Speaking with good manners is a way to speak with power."

items.q: "Simple, polite, and powerful" suggests that these phrases are…
items.why: Inferência: o texto elogia as frases como fáceis de usar e fortes ao mesmo tempo.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Ethan treinando o novo trader antes da ligação com o cliente. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Okay, let's practise before we call the client. Stay calm and be polite. Use can and could — they are your best friends here.

First, ask for a better price. Say: "Can you lower the price a little?" If the client says no, don't worry. You can answer: "I understand. Could we talk about the deadline?"

Now, the payment. The client wants thirty-day terms. That is fine for us. You can say: "We can accept thirty-day terms." Say it slowly and with a smile.

If you don't hear a number, just ask again. Say: "Could you repeat the number, please?" It is polite, and it is safe. Never guess a price.

Remember, I can offer a small discount, but I can't lower the price a lot. So be careful with that. If everything is good, we can close the deal today. You are ready. Let's make the call.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What does Ethan tell the trader to do first?
items.why: "First, ask for a better price. Say: 'Can you lower the price a little?'"

items.q: What payment terms are fine for Ethan's company?
items.why: "We can accept thirty-day terms."

items.q: What should the trader say if he does not hear the number?
items.why: "Could you repeat the number, please?" — educado e seguro.

items.q: Why does Ethan say "Never guess a price"?
options: Because guessing can cause a mistake
items.why: Inferência: é mais seguro pedir para repetir do que arriscar um número errado.

items.q: How does Ethan feel about the trader?
options: He wants to cancel the call
He is confident the trader can do it
He thinks the trader is not ready
items.why: Inferência: "You are ready. Let's make the call." — ele confia no trader.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Can you send the quote today?" Here, can shows…
options: a future plan for next year
items.why: Can = poder, usado para um pedido simples no presente.

items.q: "Could you help me, please?" We use could here to sound…
items.why: Could = poderia, deixa o pedido mais educado.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I can ___ you a small discount."
items.why: Offer = oferecer: "I can offer you a small discount."

items.q: "We can accept 30-day terms." To accept means to…
items.why: Accept = aceitar, dizer sim.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We can ___ the deadline together."
items.why: Negotiate = negociar, chegar a um acordo sobre o prazo.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem em uma negociação. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "We can close the deal today." To close the deal means to…
items.why: Close the deal = fechar o negócio, terminar o acordo.

items.q: "Can you lower the price a little?" This asks the client to…
items.why: Lower the price = baixar o preço.

items.q: "Could we extend the deadline?" This asks for…
items.why: Extend the deadline = estender o prazo, ganhar mais tempo.

items.q: "The client agreed, so we can go ahead." To go ahead means to…
items.why: Go ahead = seguir em frente, continuar.

items.q: "Let's set up a meeting on Friday." To set up a meeting means to…
items.why: Set up = marcar, organizar (um encontro).
